2124508000853364970.en_summary: $SPX $NDX $QQQ US technology stock valuations have fallen to their lowest level since the onset of the pandemic. The S&P 500 Information Technology sector is currently trading at a forward 12-month price-to-earnings ratio of approximately 16.4x matching the March 2020 COVID-19 lows of 16.1x and marking the cheapest relative valuation for the sector in more than six years. For the first time since 2017, technology now trades at a discount to the broader S&P 500 (currently around 17.7x forward). This compression reflects a sharp reset from peak multiples near 32x in late 2025. Driven by price underperformance and upward revisions to earnings estimates of roughly 17% in recent months.
2124508000853364970.zh_summary: $SPX $NDX $QQQ 美國科技股估值已跌至疫情開始以來最低水平。標普 500 信息技術板塊目前以約 16.4x 的前瞻 12 個月市盈率交易，匹配 2020 年 3 月 COVID-19 低點 16.1x，標誌著該板塊六年多以來最便宜的相對估值。自 2017 年以來首次，科技現在以折扣交易於更廣泛的標普 500（目前約 17.7x 前瞻）。這種壓縮反映從 2025 年底近 32x 峰值倍數的急劇重置。由價格表現不佳和近期約 17% 的盈利估計上修驅動。
